tasks.title: Research and select an official AWS certification exam date
tasks.description: Identify available exam dates for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification that are no later than 2026-12-15. Book the exam through the official AWS website.
tasks.done_criteria: Exam date is booked and confirmed via the official AWS portal.

tasks.title: Review AWS certification exam requirements and prepare study materials
tasks.description: Gather all required information about the exam format, content outline, and prerequisites. Create a list of study resources (books, courses, practice exams) and organize them in a study plan.
tasks.done_criteria: Study plan with resources and exam requirements is created and saved in a shared document.

tasks.title: Study AWS core services and architecture concepts
tasks.description: Dedicate time to study AWS core services, cloud architecture principles, and best practices. Focus on areas such as compute, storage, networking, security, and database services.
tasks.done_criteria: Completed study of AWS core services and architecture concepts as per the study plan.

tasks.description: Review the exam blueprint and focus on the most important topics. Practice with sample questions and review the correct answers to understand the exam format and content.
tasks.done_criteria: Completed review of exam topics and practiced with sample questions.

tasks.description: Take a full-length practice exam under exam conditions. Review the results to identify weak areas and adjust the study plan accordingly.
tasks.done_criteria: Full-length practice exam is completed and results are analyzed with a study plan update.

tasks.title: Revise weak areas and review key concepts
tasks.description: Focus on the weak areas identified in the practice exam. Review key concepts, re-study materials, and take notes on important topics.
tasks.done_criteria: Weak areas are revised and key concepts are reviewed with updated notes.

tasks.title: Take a second full-length practice exam and analyze results
tasks.description: Take a second full-length practice exam to measure progress. Analyze the results and refine the study plan if needed.
tasks.done_criteria: Second full-length practice exam is completed and results are analyzed with a final study plan update.

tasks.title: Review all study materials and prepare for the exam
tasks.description: Review all study materials, notes, and practice exams. Ensure all key concepts are understood and ready for the official exam.
tasks.done_criteria: All study materials are reviewed and the candidate is prepared for the official exam.

tasks.title: Book and confirm the official AWS certification exam
tasks.description: Book the official AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam using the confirmed date. Ensure all prerequisites are met and the exam is confirmed.
tasks.done_criteria: Official exam is booked and confirmed via the AWS portal.

tasks.title: Take the official AWS certification exam
tasks.description: Attend the official AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam on the booked date and achieve a passing score.
